doc.title: Q-Flash-Web Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: As a user, I want a comprehensive guide page with all usage instructions, so that I can learn advanced features. Sections include: Quick Start, Prerequisites, Installing Drivers, Entering EDL Mode, Using Q-Flash Tool, ROM Processing, Troubleshooting, FAQ.

doc.title: Q-Flash-Web Architecture
doc.snippet: All page components follow standard structure with useTranslation hook, page header with title/description, and main content area. Use cn() utility for className composition.

doc.title: Q-Flash-Web Architecture
doc.snippet: Page components located in src/pages/. GuidePage.tsx (renamed from Drivers) provides comprehensive usage guide with collapsible sections.

doc.title: Q-Flash-Web Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: Comprehensive guide covering: Quick Start (5 steps), Prerequisites, Driver Installation (automatic + Zadig), EDL Mode methods, Tool Usage, ROM Processing, Troubleshooting (5+ errors), FAQ (8+ questions). Fully bilingual EN/VI.

doc.title: Q-Flash-Web UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Use accordion pattern for collapsible sections. Linear Violet theme with smooth 200ms transitions. Mobile-responsive with max-width 4xl container.
